speaker: tock
text: Goodbye, friends! Come back by purple o'clock!

speaker: lumi
text: Bye, Tock! Rainbow Bridge, here we come!

speaker: bobo
text: Um... why can I see clouds through my feet?

speaker: kiko
text: Whoa-oh-oh! ...Just kidding!

speaker: draco
text: Stand back! My dragon magic will fix it!

speaker: bobo
text: Please tell me this bridge comes with a banana safety rail!

speaker: pico
text: Eep! I mean... halt! I'm very brave!

speaker: pico
text: I'm Pico, guardian of the Rainbow Bridge. The Rainbow Heart is losing its magic!

speaker: kiko
text: Boo!

speaker: bobo
text: Wait! Were you blue, green, purple, or a walking rainbow?

speaker: pico
text: Um... even I forgot!

speaker: pico
text: Each island lost its colour orbs. We need all seven!

speaker: bobo
text: Ooh! A giant orange! Breakfast!

speaker: draco
text: Easy! I'll fly to the next island!

speaker: draco
text: I meant to do that!

speaker: kiko
text: Of course you did!

speaker: pico
text: Every colour is a gift. Courage, friendship, happiness, kindness, trust, imagination, and hope!

speaker: lumi
text: Rainbow order! Red first, violet last!

speaker: lumi
text: Bobo, that's not a rainbow colour!

speaker: bobo
text: It should be. It's banana!

speaker: draco
text: I knew that all along!

speaker: pico
text: It's fading... I'm not a good guardian.

speaker: lumi
text: Yes, you are, Pico! We'll do it together!

speaker: pico
text: Rainbow... shine!

speaker: bobo
text: I look like a banana that went on vacation!

speaker: kiko
text: Hee hee... Pico? Where did you go?

speaker: bobo
text: A rainbow banana! Who wants to share?

speaker: bobo
text: Hey!

speaker: lumi
text: Listen! I think our next adventure has a secret melody!

speaker: narrator
text: Next time... the mystery of the magical music box!
